summary: Stop scattering node.z — depth tunnel makes the graph seasick
description: Bug: viewer.js assigns each node a rotating z from ((i % 4) - 1.5) * 40 before graphData. Combined with dagMode('lr'), clusters recede into the distance like a tunnel. The 3D page looks sparse and the camera feels nauseating because nodes sit at different depths. Product code still has this scatter; do not leave it. Pin every node z to 0 so the layout is a left-to-right plane, not a depth stack.
scope: In src/living_graph/static/viewer.js set node.z = 0 for each node before graphData
acceptanceCriteria: viewer.js contains node.z = 0 and does not contain i % 4 used to set z.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add a watcher or CLI unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not add npm or a bundler.
